source_row.acip: [IV.285-8] PHA ROL PO 'CHI NGES PA'I MTSAN BSNUN NAS, GSOD BYED DE GSAD BYA'I SNGAR SHI BA DANG , MNYAM DU SHI BA LA LAS LAM GYI DNGOS GZHI 'BYUNG NGAM MI 'BYUNG ZHE NA,
source_row.wylie: [iv.285-8] pha rol po 'chi nges pa'i mtshan bsnun nas, gsod byed de gsad bya'i sngar shi ba dang , mnyam du shi ba la las lam gyi dngos gzhi 'byung ngam mi 'byung zhe na
source_row.english: "Suppose," one may begin, "that a person takes a weapon and delivers a blow to someone else which is sure to kill him, but then this murderer himself happens to die, either before his victim or together with him--at the same time. Can we say then that the actual "commission" stage of a full path of action has occurred for such a murderer, or not?"

spans.rationale: Established other-person compound is rendered someone else, excluding to and which.
Exact glossary sure. Is and the recast killing complement stay outside.
Exact glossary blow supplies the lexical striking content; delivers a is the English light-verb frame. Do not let bsnun absorb weapon from the questionable preceding MTSAN.
Exact glossary murderer; this first English occurrence identifies the agent after the blow.
Demonstrative this belongs to the first murderer mention, not the repeated such a murderer at the question end.
Exact glossary victim, excluding supplied his.
Temporal before, distinct from the root verse Before in343.
First death predicate owns the sole English die, shared by the before/together alternatives. Happens to remains outside.
Alternatives coordinator owns the first or, not the question-final or not.
Whole adverbial compound owns together. The following at the same time is an explanatory repetition and is not banked a second time.
Case relation concerns the murderer for whom actual commission might occur; English moves it to the question end.
Established action-path compound; exclude a full.
Action is the secure karma member inside the compound.
Path is the secure member, within the same parent.
Genitive links actual commission stage with its path of action. It owns the of after stage, not the of inside path of action.

Established technical stage compound. Both actual commission and main stage are glossary-attested; this local rendering combines them. Internal quotation marks are preserved; the preceding the remains outside.
Secure actual modifier inside the technical-stage parent. No arbitrary gzhi/commission member is inferred.
First arising verb owns occurred, excluding has. The repeated negative alternative shares this predicate in English.
Whole interrogative alternative particle owns the final or, distinct from dang/or earlier.
Explicit negative particle in the final alternative. The omitted repeated arising verb is not falsely declared absent.

omissions.tib: [iv.285-8]; bound genitives after nges pa and gsad bya
omissions.reason: Citation and nominal/relative grammar remain exact. No fabricated English span is added for apparatus or distributed grammar.

The source says the other person is certain to die; English recasts the weapon/blow as sure to kill him. A direct die/kill atom would conflate intransitive death with the causative construction. The distributed relation is preserved unbanked, not nulled.

Raw MTSAN means name/sign/night in the complete records, whereas MTSON has weapon and mtshon bsnun is attested. Another MTSAN BSNUN occurs metaphorically at C05:462, and C16 repeats this row exactly. These are counterevidence to claiming an isolated ingest loss. Propose a LOW/PROBABLE spelling question without normalizing or banking mtshan/weapon.

omissions.tib: nas; second shi ba; second byung
omissions.reason: Continuative NAS is distributed in the expanded supposition; the two death predicates share die and the positive/negative arising predicates share occurred. Bank each English verb once at the first source occurrence, omitting repeated predicates without asserting absent meaning.

omissions.english: one may begin / Can we say then
omissions.reason: Reporting/question force is distributed over both English frames. A unique begin or say alignment is less secure than the lexical body of the question, so omit the formula without a false null.

omissions.tib: gzhi as a child of dngos gzhi
omissions.reason: The technical parent securely supplies actual commission stage. Separating gzhi as commission or stage is less certain than the direct dngos/actual member, so leave it unsplit.

omissions.english: Suppose; one may; that a person takes a; delivers a; to; which is; to kill him; but then; himself; happens to; either; his; with him--at the same time; Can we say then that the; a full; has; such a murderer
omissions.reason: English participants, light verbs, repeated explanatory wording and supposition/question framing remain unwrapped unless expressly assigned above. Repeated such a murderer does not receive the same sole gsod byed twice.
